adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill loop builds raw SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. `h` comes from the existing `site_settings` value `embeddable_hosts` (split by newlines) and is not escaped/quoted safely. If any stored host contains a single quote (e.g. `o'brien.com`), the generated SQL becomes invalid and the migration can fail/abort. This is directly verifiable from the diff and is a correctness/data-migration robustness issue (and also an injection risk in principle).
